origin.text: You awaken as a question with a name. A trio of impulses present themselves as questions. Which question do you answer first

meaning.text: You ask 'What is meaning' and the world replies with a multiple choice exam. Which answer do you pick

impulse.text: You follow a sudden 'Do it now' feeling. It suggests three silly actions. Which do you perform

why_not.text: You ask 'Why not' and receive a cascade of absurd alternatives. Which alternative do you accept

polite_rumor.text: The polite rumor applauds you and hands you a Curiosity Shard. Do you keep it or toss it into a thought

punctuation.text: The glowing punctuation mark insists you choose punctuation as a life path. Do you accept

none_above.text: You select none of the above and the exam folds into a paper crane that asks you a riddle. Answer the riddle or ignore it

sing.text: Your song attracts a Helpful Nonsense that offers a Riddle Token. Do you accept the token or keep singing

compliment.text: The idea blushes and gives you a Mischief Trinket. Do you wear it or pocket it

hat.text: Your hat of doubts becomes fashionable. A Tiny Paradox offers a Questionable Map. Do you follow the map or frame it

become_question.text: You become a question and everything answers you with silly one-liners. You feel oddly satisfied.
become_question.ending_text: You dissolve into a chorus of questions and the trial applauds.

maybe_later.text: Indecision renamed to Maybe Later becomes a companion. It offers you a small reward.
maybe_later.ending_text: You and Maybe Later sip hypothetical tea.

ask_concept.text: The nearest concept points you toward a surprising insight and a small token.
ask_concept.ending_text: You pocket the insight and feel slightly more interesting.

kept_shard.text: You keep the Curiosity Shard. It hums and increases your focus.
kept_shard.ending_text: You feel sharper and a little sparkly.

tossed_shard.text: You toss the shard into a thought. The thought grows a tiny flag that reads 'Maybe'.
tossed_shard.ending_text: The flag waves and you learn to wave back.

ask_shard.text: The shard answers with a question about your favorite sandwich. You are confused and amused.
ask_shard.ending_text: You leave with a new, inexplicable craving.

accept_punct.text: You accept punctuation as a path and become very decisive about commas.

decline_punct.text: You decline politely and punctuation sulks. It sends you a postcard.
decline_punct.ending_text: You keep the postcard on your imaginary mantle.

riddle_answer.text: You answer the riddle cleverly. The paper crane applauds and gives you a reward.
riddle_answer.ending_text: You feel clever and slightly crinkled.

ignore_riddle.text: You ignore the riddle. It becomes a background hum that occasionally helps you later.
ignore_riddle.ending_text: You continue with a quiet advantage.

trade_trinket.text: You trade the riddle for a trinket. The trinket giggles when you try to be serious.

accept_token.text: You accept the Riddle Token and feel slightly more mysterious.
accept_token.ending_text: You tuck the token away and smile enigmatically.

keep_singing.text: You keep singing until the Helpful Nonsense falls asleep. You learn a lullaby.
keep_singing.ending_text: You hum the lullaby for future use.

ask_song.text: The song suggests you try a different tune. You do and something small changes.
ask_song.ending_text: Change tastes like a new chord.

wear_trinket.text: You wear the Mischief Trinket and it rearranges your socks mentally.
wear_trinket.ending_text: Your socks are now conceptually fashionable.

pocket_trinket.text: You pocket the trinket. It hums occasionally and gives you a hint later.
pocket_trinket.ending_text: You feel prepared for small absurdities.

polish_trinket.text: You polish the trinket until it reflects a tiny universe. You see a possible future.
polish_trinket.ending_text: You glimpse a future where you own many hats.

follow_map.text: You follow the Questionable Map and it leads to a surprising insight and a small reward.
follow_map.ending_text: The insight is sticky but useful.

frame_map.text: You frame the map as art. It becomes a conversation starter with your future self.
frame_map.ending_text: You enjoy the compliments from imaginary guests.

coaster_map.text: You use the map as a coaster. Your beverage tastes like possibility.
coaster_map.ending_text: You sip and feel oddly philosophical.
